jobs.description:
Your role
Do you want to play a key role in ensuring that customers and our global Service organization have access to the right spare parts at the right time?
 
As a Spare Parts Specialist, you will bridge product development and aftermarket operations by managing spare parts information throughout the product lifecycle. Working with a global portfolio of primarily mechanical products, you will collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Service, Supply Chain, and Product Management to ensure high-quality spare parts data, strong aftermarket readiness, and continuous improvement of our processes and tools. 
 
What you will do:
Maintain and develop spare parts information throughout the product lifecycle
Create and maintain technical documentation, product structures, exploded-view illustrations, and recommended spare parts lists
Support new product introductions and ensure aftermarket readiness
Perform spare parts pricing based on defined pricing formulas and principles
Support the global Service organization with technical spare parts expertise
Drive improvements in data quality, digital tools, and ways of working 

 
You will become part of a global organization where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning drive our success. This is an opportunity to make a real impact on customer support, spare parts availability, and the future development of our aftermarket business.
 
Your skills and experience
 
An engineering degree or equivalent technical experience, preferably within mechanical engineering
Experience from spare parts, aftermarket, service, technical support, engineering, or a related field
The ability to understand technical drawings and product documentation
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
A structured and collaborative way of working
Experience with SAP, Salesforce, Windchill, or similar systems is an advantage
Fluency in English 

Your job location
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our office in Stockholm, Sweden (SE).
 
Application process
Our selection process includes interviews, skills assessments and a background check. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

Join our customer in Ludvika and play a key role in optimizing long-term production plans within a highly complex manufacturing environment.
About the role
As a Master Planner, you will support the planning organization by developing the long-term production plan. You will collaborate closely with operations, project management, engineering, and sales to align customer demand with capacity.
We offer a dynamic role in a global and highly collaborative environment where you can directly influence large-scale industrial projects and optimize critical production processes.
Work tasks
The role entails aligning customer demand, project requirements, and production capacity to ensure a smooth and optimized manufacturing flow.
Develop, maintain, and continuously evaluate the master production plan.  
Balance demand, capacity, and production constraints across the entire manufacturing facility.  
Identify long-term bottlenecks, risks, and planning conflicts, driving scenarios to support decision-making.  
Coordinate planning activities across departments to align priorities and production sequences.  
Monitor changes and deviations affecting the long-term plan and recommend corrective planning actions.

We are looking for
Advanced knowledge in production planning, master scheduling, or scheduling within a complex manufacturing environment
Good understanding of capacity planning, production flows, and bottleneck management
Advanced knowledge of Excel and strong analytical skills
Experience from working in SAP
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

It is meritorious if you have
Good knowledge of Swedish
Experience with engineer-to-order or project-based manufacturing

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stress tolerant
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Mission Brief 
 
The Test Operations Engineer is part of a multidisciplinary team responsible for the development and verification testing of liquid rocket engines and their subsystems. The role focuses on the planning, execution, and evaluation of propulsion tests, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable test operations while coordinating closely with design, maintenance, and operations teams.
Your Role in Our Space Mission: 
Plan and coordinate propulsion test campaigns, supporting development, verification, and qualification activities.
Develop, review, and execute test procedures, operational documentation, and risk assessments.
Operate and monitor tests from the control room, ensuring safe execution and responding to off-nominal conditions.
Analyze test and facility data to verify test objectives, investigate anomalies, and support root cause analysis.
Develop and continuously improve test operations procedures, work instructions, and processes.
Collaborate with design, maintenance, and facility engineering teams to prepare, commission, operate, and improve test facilities and ground support equipment.
Support system commissioning, operational readiness reviews, and the introduction of new test capabilities.

 
Qualification Checklist 
Relevant technical qualification, bachelor's or master's degree in aerospace, mechanical, chemical, industrial engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on experience operating, maintaining, testing, or developing complex mechanical or fluid systems.
Experience with process systems involving gases, liquids, pressure systems, pumps, valves, instrumentation, or similar industrial equipment.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically and implement practical corrective actions.
Understanding of engineering fundamentals and the ability to support design, modification, and commissioning activities.
Comfortable working in fast-paced test environments and maintaining focus during critical operations.
Physical dexterity is required, as the role may involve working in confined spaces and on industrial equipment.
Able to lift and carry up to 25 kg.
Fluent in English.

 
Bonus Skills 
Experience with high-pressure, cryogenic, hazardous, flammable, or other demanding process systems.
Hands-on experience with fluid systems, piping, tubing, valves, regulators, and instrumentation.
Experience planning and performing maintenance on industrial or test equipment.
Experience commissioning new equipment, facilities, or process systems.
Familiarity with data analysis and interpretation of test or operational data.
Experience with at least one programming or scripting language (Python, MATLAB, C#, etc.).

ABOUT COGNIZANT
Cognizant is a leading global technology and professional services company that drives digital transformation for enterprises worldwide. We combine deep industry expertise, advanced technology capabilities, and human-centered design to solve complex business challenges. We're proud to partner with Google on mission-critical projects like Google Maps, where accuracy and attention to detail directly impact millions of users globally.

THE ROLE
Are you detail-oriented with a passion for geographic accuracy? Join our team as a Locality Expert, where you'll verify and validate Maps Data to ensure it reflects real-world changes. You'll audit critical geographic attributes—locations, names, platforms, entrances, exits, and transit positions across different transportation modes—by comparing them against trustworthy sources via web research. Your work ensures millions of users have accurate, real-time geographic information.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Audit Maps Data against real-world conditions and trustworthy sources to verify accuracy. You'll evaluate and update critical geographic attributes, work independently while managing your performance metrics, and meet defined SLA/TAT timelines. You'll also identify opportunities for improvement and communicate insights to your team lead, contributing to continuous quality enhancement.

WHO YOU ARE
Experience / Skills
● 3+ years of experience in the automotive industry or Urban planning, Traffics/ Transit/ Signals/ Signages
● Strong understanding of market research methodologies and techniques.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Local language and in English
● Native / Bilingual (B2+) in Swedish language
● Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
● Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Excellent time management and organizational skills.
● Strong analytical, excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills
Nice-to-have skills include experience with vector data analysis, basic GIS map component knowledge, and PL/SQL basics.

WHY JOIN US?
Make global impact every day—your work directly influences how millions of people navigate the world. You'll develop specialized expertise in geospatial data quality within a team dedicated to excellence. Join Cognizant and grow with a global technology leader offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Become a specialist in a rapidly growing field of data quality assurance.

jobs.occupation: Specialist Doctors in Internal Medicine Wanted for Mora Hospital, Sweden
jobs.description:
Medicinkliniken Mora is looking for experienced specialist doctors who wish to work in a broad and clinically stimulating internal medicine environment while enjoying the exceptional quality of life that Dalarna has to offer.

Mora Hospital serves a large geographical area and offers a varied patient population. As part of the Department of Internal Medicine, you will work closely with colleagues from multiple specialties while contributing to both inpatient and outpatient care.

This position is particularly suitable for specialists who appreciate broad clinical work, close collaboration and opportunities to influence and develop healthcare services.

Why Mora?
Mora is located in the heart of Dalarna and is surrounded by forests, lakes and mountains. The area is well known for outdoor activities, a strong sense of community and a healthy work-life balance.
Mora Hospital combines the advantages of a smaller hospital environment with access to modern healthcare and specialist expertise.
We Are Looking For
We are currently recruiting specialists within:
.Internal Medicine
.Nephrology
.Endocrinology / Diabetology
.Gastroenterology
.Hematology

Applicants with a background in general internal medicine and an interest in one or more of these subspecialties are also encouraged to apply.

Candidate Profile
To be considered for this position, you should:
.Be a licensed specialist doctor within the EU/EEA
.Hold EU/EEA citizenship
.Have at least 5 years of relevant specialist experience
.Possess English language skills at CEFR B2 level
.Have strong professional references
.Demonstrate excellent teamwork and communication skills
.Be committed to high-quality, patient-centred care

We Offer
.A 22-week intensive Swedish language programme, starting in either February or August each year. Participants receive an educational salary while studying Swedish towards C1 level, a requirement for obtaining Swedish medical licensure.
.A modern working environment
.Broad clinical work and professional autonomy
.Excellent opportunities for continuing medical education
.At least 25 days of paid vacation per year
.A permanent contract, conditioned with at least 2 years of service in Region Dalarna
.Support with moving costs via EURES/TMS, https://arbetsformedlingen.se/for-arbetssokande/sa-hittar-du-jobbet/hitta-jobbet-utomlands/eures-targeted-mobility-scheme-tms-sweden/for-arbetssokande
.Assistance for partners/spouses in finding work opportunities in Dalarna
